snp2.5:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Gayāyaṃ viharati Ṭaṃkitamañce Sūcilomassa yakkhassa bhavane.
snp2.5:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Kharo ca yakkho Sūcilomo ca yakkho Bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti.
snp2.5:1.4: Atha kho Kharo yakkho Sūcilomaṃ yakkhaṃ etad avora:
snp2.5:1.7: yāva jānāmi yadi vā so samaṇo yadi vā samaṇako" ti.
snp2.5:2.1: Atha kho Sūcilomo yakkho yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmesi.
snp2.5:2.3: Atha kho Sūcilomo yakkho Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
snp2.5:2.6: api ca kho te samphasso pāpako" ti.
snp2.5:3.2: sace me na vyākarissasi, cittaṃ vā te khipissāmi, hadayaṃ vā te phāḷessāmi, pādesu vā gahetvā pāra-Gaṅgāya khipissāmī" ti.
snp2.5:4.1: "Na khv-āhan taṃ āvuso passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yo me cittaṃ vā khipeyya hadayaṃ vā phāḷeyya pādesu vā gahetvā pāra-Gaṅgāya khipeyya,
snp2.5:4.2: api ca tvaṃ āvuso puccha yad ākaṃkhasī" ti.
snp2.5:4.3: Atha kho Sūcilomo yakkho Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi: 270.
